about: The decision a person says is right at a moment of a real call. A label is anchored by `said` (words of the turn, matched to the first turn of the other side that contains them), never by turn id. expect.decision: responder | reconducir | aplazar | cerrar | null (a point with no decision: only the honest answer) | none (no point should come from that turn). `confirmed` is true only once Dani set or accepted it: the agreement gate is provisional until then. Generate a sheet to label from with `python -m evals.copilot.label_sheet run.json`.
